headlines.title: MAGA activists protest AI data centers at Big Tech headquarters in San Francisco
headlines.description: The group, called Humans First, advocates for better guardrails on data center construction and AI in general.

headlines.title: Aiming at fuel costs, Trump opens tax-exempt ‘red dye’ diesel to all drivers
headlines.description: Trump signed an executive order intended to help bring down sky-high diesel prices by allowing anyone to purchase tax-exempt “red dye” diesel.

headlines.title: Global tech policymakers agree to embrace AI in science
headlines.description: A joint statement issued by the U.S. and 15 other countries touts the technology’s potential to accelerate scientific progress.

headlines.title: Senate Democrats block Husted-led bill on data centers, calling it ‘toothless’
headlines.description: The bill aims to prevent data centers from spiking local utility costs. Republicans accused Democrats of playing political games, noting the bill passed the House 417-3.

headlines.title: Trump announces members of ‘Super Intelligence Force’ to coordinate AI policy
headlines.description: President Donald Trump announced the formation of an AI task force, naming National Intelligence Director Jay Clayton to lead it.

headlines.title: OpenAI CEO Sam Altman says people need to 'accept some bad things' for the benefits of AI
headlines.description: When asked by Politico about the difference between OpenAI and other AI companies who seek more regulation, OpenAI CEO Sam Altman said people need to "accept some bad things" for the benefits of the technology. NBC News' Brian Cheung reports.

headlines.title: New tech promises to lift entire cities and roads above flood waters
headlines.description: A Bay Area startup is building "mechanical bison"—autonomous robots that inject woodchips 60 feet deep to literally raise sinking land. Father-son inventors hope this terraforming tech can save flood-prone cities from rising sea levels.

headlines.title: California AG Bonta issues subpoena against OpenAI over cybersecurity risk
headlines.description: California Attorney General Rob Bonta speaks with NBC News’ Gadi Schwartz about issuing an investigative subpoena to OpenAI regarding cybersecurity risks and legal concerns.

headlines.title: Could humanoid robot soldiers be on the horizon?
headlines.description: Meet Phantom, the robot Foundation Future Industries says could be one of the first humanoid robot soldiers. The Eric Trump-backed company already has $24 million in contracts with the Pentagon to develop humanoids for defense. Foundation's CEO Sankaet Pathak speaks to Tom Llamas.

headlines.title: NASA, SpaceX launch Crew-13 mission to International Space Station
headlines.description: The NASA and SpaceX Crew-13 mission launched successfully from Cape Canaveral, Florida, toward the International Space Station. NASA astronauts Jessica Watkins and Luke Delaney are joined by Roscosmos cosmonaut Sergey Teteryatnikov and CSA astronaut Joshua Kutryk.

headlines.title: Bare nails debated as BBC takes down story after getting slammed for tying trend to class
headlines.description: The BBC is facing backlash after tying the "bare nails" trend in the beauty world to class and culture. Some media outlets argue the style is not a new topic of the culture wars. NBC News’ Allie Canal reports.

headlines.title: Trump hosts tech leaders for meeting on A.I.
headlines.description: President Trump released an agreement signed by top tech leaders on increasing standards for A.I. NBC News’ Gabe Gutierrez reports.
